prompt_meta.title: REAL Simulator Proof: Show NoriJjak UI (NOT Expo screens) + Demo Pack + Manifest Cleanup

explicit_examples: Any screen that does not show NoriJjak branding or in-app UI
disallowed_proof_screens.rule: If any captured screenshot is not the NoriJjak app UI, delete it, recapture, and mark previous proof as INVALID in the report.

step_objectives.goal: Produce Owner-verifiable simulator proof that the NoriJjak app UI is running (not Expo screens), and package it in a single GitHub-viewable demo doc.
outcomes: Android emulator boots and shows NoriJjak UI
Auth + Onboarding flow is visually proven via screenshots AND a short recording
A single demo markdown doc renders in GitHub with embedded images and a link to the recording
ops/manifest.json is cleaned (duplicate STEP-0014 removed) and gains owner verification fields
definition_of_done: At least 14 VALID screenshots exist (all are NoriJjak UI) under reports/assets/STEP-0021/
At least 1 short recording exists (mp4 OR gif) showing NoriJjak UI end-to-end
ops/DEMO_MOBILE_AUTH_ONBOARDING.md exists and is GitHub-clickable with embedded images
manifest has unique step IDs (remove duplicate STEP-0014) and adds owner_verified fields

must_show: A screen where the visible UI contains NoriJjak branding (놀이짝 or NoriJjak)
At least one in-app page that is clearly NOT an Expo UI

required_screenshots: Locale switch KO->EN or EN->KO proof
One extra screen proving app navigation (not Expo)

recording.must_show_flow: Open app -> Login/Signup -> Onboarding -> Success (all inside NoriJjak UI)

proof_requirements.storage_rule: All assets must be stored under reports/assets/STEP-0021/ and referenced by repo-relative paths in the demo doc.

must_fix: Remove duplicate STEP-0014 entry (keep only one)
Ensure each step id is unique
Add fields to each step: owner_verified (boolean), owner_verified_at (nullable), proof_doc_path (nullable)
manifest_cleanup_rules.owner_verified_policy: Set owner_verified=false for all steps by default. Set proof_doc_path for STEP-0019/0020/0021 after demo doc is created.

tasks.name: Invalidate incorrect proof
tasks.objective: Audit any prior proof assets (STEP-0019/0020) and explicitly mark Expo-screen evidence as INVALID in the STEP-0021 report.
acceptance: Report contains a clear statement: prior screenshot was Expo Account screen and is invalid proof.

tasks.name: Bring up emulator and launch NoriJjak UI
tasks.objective: Ensure Android emulator runs and the NoriJjak app UI is opened (not Expo account/project pages).
acceptance: At least 1 screenshot clearly shows NoriJjak UI with branding.

tasks.name: Capture VALID screenshots + recording
tasks.objective: Capture 14+ screenshots + 1 short recording. All must be NoriJjak app screens. Delete and recapture any Expo screens.
acceptance: All required screenshots exist and are valid.
Recording exists and shows the flow inside NoriJjak UI.

tasks.name: Create GitHub-clickable demo doc
tasks.objective: Write ops/DEMO_MOBILE_AUTH_ONBOARDING.md with embedded images and a link to the recording.
acceptance: Doc renders on GitHub and references repo-relative image paths.

tasks.name: Fix ops/manifest.json duplication + owner verification fields
tasks.objective: Remove duplicate STEP-0014 entry and add owner verification fields across steps.
acceptance: Manifest JSON is valid and step IDs are unique.

tasks.name: Push to main + report
tasks.objective: Commit and push all changes to origin/main and write reports/STEP-0021.report.json.
acceptance: Report includes main commit hash and exact GitHub paths the Owner should open.

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute exactly. The attached screenshot is Expo Go Account UI and is INVALID proof. Produce VALID proof that shows NoriJjak app UI on Android emulator (not Expo screens), capture 14+ screenshots + 1 short recording, generate a GitHub-viewable demo doc with embedded images, fix manifest duplication and add owner verification fields, push to origin/main, and write a complete STEP-0021 report with no placeholders.
